# QuantizationAwareSpiking

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The integration of weight/activation quantization directly into the spiking conversion process, aligning discrete spike representations with quantized neural network values. This bridges the gap between digital ANN training and analog/neuromorphic spike-based execution, enabling efficient hardware mapping.
